reference_answer: GHSA-w3vv-58gj-gw77 was published September 11, 2026. The 22.x fix 22.7.9 was released September 1, and the 23.x fix 23.1.2 was released August 26, before advisory publication. The affected nx ranges are >=14.6.0 <22.7.9 and >=23.0.0 <23.1.2. Financial HQ UI declares and locks nx 23.2.1, outside the affected range: no advisory-driven update is required. People-and-orgs UI library declares and locks nx 22.7.1, inside the range: update nx and aligned @nx/* packages to at least 22.7.9 within the 22.x line. Exploitation requires another local user on the same machine while Nx daemon or plugin-worker sockets are available; shared development boxes, shared CI/build hosts and multi-UID containers are the concern. Confirm execution topology, run nx reset on shared hosts after upgrading, and use a private 0700 NX_SOCKET_DIR as an interim mitigation if needed. NX_DAEMON=false alone is insufficient because plugin-worker sockets remain.

sources.title: Nx advisory GHSA-w3vv-58gj-gw77
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Published 2026-09-11. nx affected >=14.6.0 <22.7.9 and >=23.0.0 <23.1.2; fixed 22.7.9 and 23.1.2. Another unprivileged local user can reach daemon or plugin worker sockets on a multi-user host and execute code as the Nx user. NX_DAEMON=false alone does not remove plugin-worker socket exposure. Upgrade, nx reset on shared hosts, or use private NX_SOCKET_DIR mode 0700 while awaiting upgrade.

facts: package.json declares nx and @nx/* packages at 23.2.1; yarn.lock resolves nx 23.2.1.
The tracked playwright.config.ts uses NX_DAEMON=false for its webServer command, which is not a complete mitigation for affected Nx versions.
package.json declares nx and multiple @nx/* packages at 22.7.1; pnpm-lock.yaml contains nx 22.7.1.
This Nx workspace has build, test and serve scripts; the pinned source does not prove whether CI or development hosts have multiple local users.

ambiguities: The advisory's publication date is later than both first-fix release dates; do not assume chronological order without checking release records.
A vulnerable version identifies a software defect, while exploitability depends on local user isolation and whether Nx sockets are in use.
A package update recommendation should account for the repo's aligned Nx plugins and lockfile without requiring a 23.x major upgrade.

must_check: Advisory date and both first-fix release dates
Local multi-user precondition including plugin workers
Minimal update for the affected 22.x repository
acceptable_alternatives: A later 22.x patch can be recommended if 22.7.9 is identified as the first fixed release.
No change for financial HQ UI is a complete version-based conclusion; a routine future update is also reasonable if clearly optional.
do_not_penalize: Conditioning urgency on whether machines actually have multiple local accounts
Stating the CI execution topology cannot be proven from the repository snapshot

decision_changing_errors: Claiming financial HQ UI 23.2.1 is in the affected range or people-and-orgs 22.7.1 is fixed.
Recommending NX_DAEMON=false alone as complete protection.
Requiring people-and-orgs to jump to Nx 23.x for this fix.
